attributes.name: Church of Potteto
attributes.description:
~~Barely a scanlation team.~~ I guess we're a scan team now or whateva.

__PROJECTS (_in order of priority_):__
1. [Sexy Cosplay Doll](https://mangadex.org/title/aa6c76f7-5f5f-46b6-a800-911145f81b9b/sono-bisque-doll-wa-koi-wo-suru)
2. [Hitomi-chan Is Shy With Strangers](https://mangadex.org/title/6cc0f7c2-0db6-432b-8189-fcedbcdda888/hitomi-chan-wa-hitomishiri)
3. [Story of a Small Senior in My Company](https://mangadex.org/title/cef6253d-6a55-4438-921c-46968b426f2f/story-of-a-small-senior-in-my-company)

We occasionally scanlate random My Dress-Up Darling doujinshi (SFW only), [clips from](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YmEvfBF_UkM) [the radio show](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y3uh8vGKqvM), and anything else we feel like doing, like [a VN-style video for a bonus Drama CD](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kvNa0_HB9EQ) or [a two chapter oneshot with a Marin-clone](https://mangadex.org/title/abad18cf-bf72-4bbc-97c8-b55dfa28f9b9/the-cutest-girl-closest-to-me).

We will not work on any Viz simulpubbed series because we want to avoid any C&D, we want to support the official release, and we find it's a waste of resources when we can work on other series. The official versions are usually ripped and uploaded to aggregate sites within a few days of release for those who do not live in North America. 

__Scan and Friends:__
- [Sho Habby Scans](https://mangadex.org/group/2015e273-89af-41f6-9488-cae400463c93/sho-habby-scans)
- [Emergency Tsumiki Committee ](https://mangadex.org/group/e62b19b7-e4a2-4119-a7c3-31b1c278ea59/emergency-tsumiki-committee)
